t: David Sylvian / vinyl reissues – SuperDeluxeEdition
s: The work is described by Sylvian as “a modern kind of chamber music. Intimate, dynamic, emotive, democratic, economical”. It’s worth pointing out that the original Blemish pressing was half-speed mastered and that does not appear to be the case for the vinyl reissue, although both records have been recut for vinyl by engineer Tony Cousins at Metropolis studios.
